snippet.title: Wildcard Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the action with your first full look at Wildcard in motion. This trailer pulls back the curtain on the heart-pounding gameplay that blends strategic deck-building, real-time PvP combat, and arena-shaking hype.

What You’ll See in This Trailer:
- Fast-paced 3rd-person arena combat
- Champions + card-based strategy in real time
- Massive energy, intense plays, and 2v2 action
- Explosive visuals that bring every Summon to life

Ready to Join the Fight?
🔥 Play Early Access on Steam Now!
 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/497120/Wildcard/

What is Wildcard?

Wildcard is a third-person, 2v2 Collectible Card Action Game (CCAG) that seamlessly blends fast-paced arena combat with strategic deck building. As a champion, you battle in real-time, summoning powerful creatures from your deck to fight alongside you. Master dynamic abilities, outplay opponents with skillful action mechanics, and harness the power of your summons in a thrilling fusion of collectible card strategy and third-person action combat—all set in a live, interactive arena.

PLAY NOW : 
http://play.wildcardgame.com/steam 

DISCORD:
https://discord.gg/QZRgv9M2UZ

See you in the Arena!
